growBusiness.title: One of the UAE's Most Affordable Free Zones
growBusiness.paragraph1: Setting up in Ajman Free Zone (AFZ) provides entrepreneurs, SMEs, and global investors with one of the UAE's most affordable and business-friendly environments. Strategically located near Ajman Port and within easy reach of Dubai and Sharjah.
growBusiness.paragraph2: AFZ is especially attractive for start-ups, traders, service providers, e-commerce entrepreneurs, and small manufacturers looking for a cost-effective setup.
growBusiness.paragraph3: At Setup Zone Dubai, we make setting up in Ajman Free Zone simple and hassle-free. From choosing the right license to handling visas, approvals, and compliance — we tailor solutions to match your budget and needs.

ourServices.title: What Services Do We Offer for AFZA Company Setup?
ourServices.paragraph1: We provide a complete, end-to-end suite of business formation services for Ajman Free Zone. From step one, we help you reserve your trade name with AFZA, ensuring it's compliant and not similar to any other registered name.
ourServices.paragraph2: Our experts handle the entire license application process — trading, service, industrial, or freelance — as quickly and accurately as possible. We also help you choose the right workspace — smart office, coworking, warehouse, or LIU — based on your budget.
ourServices.paragraph3: We offer visa services (investor, employee, family), compliance support (UBO, VAT, ESR, AML), annual renewals, and PRO services. We also offer web development, branding, and digital marketing to launch your business with a professional identity.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Ajman Free Zone. Still have questions? We're one message away.

items.q: How long does it take to set up a business in the Ajman Free Zone?
items.a: Typically 2-3 working days depending on required documents, office type, and license chosen.

items.q: Can a foreigner own 100% of a company in the Ajman Free Zone?
items.a: Yes. AFZ allows 100% foreign ownership — no local sponsor required.

items.q: What types of licenses are available in the Ajman Free Zone?
items.a: Trading, Service, Industrial, Freelancer, Offshore licenses, and bundled Company Formation Packages.

items.q: Is the Ajman Free Zone a good option for e-commerce?
items.a: Absolutely. AFZ offers E-commerce licenses and supports digital business models with flexible office and warehouse solutions.

items.q: Are there tax incentives in Ajman Free Zone?
items.a: Yes. 0% personal and corporate tax, plus VAT exemption available for international trading and exporting businesses.

items.q: What types of office and/or warehouse are available?
items.a: Serviced Smart Offices, Light Industrial Units (LIUs), customizable leasing, large warehouses, and business centers.

items.q: Do I need a physical office to start a company in AFZ?
items.a: Not necessarily. Flexi-desk and coworking options are available for freelancers and remote teams.

items.q: Can I apply for residency visas through Ajman Free Zone?
items.a: Yes. AFZ provides investor visas, employee visas, and family sponsorship — with full PRO support for medicals, Emirates ID, and visa stamping.

items.q: How is Ajman Free Zone different from other UAE Free Zones?
items.a: Lower setup costs, prime location near Ajman Port, flexible leasing, 24/7 smart e-government portal, and VAT benefits for exporters.

items.q: What services does Setup Zone Dubai provide for AFZA company setup?
items.a: End-to-end services — trade name reservation, license application, office/warehouse selection, visa services, compliance (UBO, VAT, ESR, AML), annual renewals, PRO, web development, branding, and marketing.
